newsitem.title: UK: London Japanese stocks weak amid political gloom.
newsitem.headline: London Japanese stocks weak amid political gloom.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were slightly weaker on Wednesday, on distrust of a sharp recovery in late trading in Tokyo and continued worries about political instability after the inconclusive general election.
The Nikkei 50/Ise index was down 9.87 points at 1,428.30 in early afternoon trading. The Nikkei 225 Average closed 41.53 points lower at 21,085.15 after dropping as low as 20,791.48.
"The Tokyo market shot up just before the close and people think that market has some correcting to do...that is reflected in weaker London prices," one dealer said.
Relatively low volume in Tokyo also dampened enthusiasm.
"In a day where you're seeing volume in Tokyo in the two hundred millions, you won't see a lot going through in London," a second dealer said.
Political worries continued to overshadow the market and were likely to consign it to thin range trade, dealers said.

"We're still no closer to solving this one because the LDP is still trying to form a coalition...Until that is done, we won't have any clues on deregulation or budgets -- and that will deter foreign investors," the first dealer said.
Traders said interest in London remained modest but noted some demand for banks, notably Tokai and Fuji.
Losers included Shin-Etsu Chemical and NEC .
